text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait Chamber of Commerce and Industry to hold a training program for young businessmen.
- Kuwait investments in Tunisia amount to $500 million, says Tunisian minister.
- Some 16 investment projects with Kuwaiti investors were approved, Egyptian industry minister says.
- U.S. troops begin to arrive in Kuwait and Washington confirms deploying Patriots on Kuwaiti land.
- Communications Minister says no reservations on American-Kuwaiti joint ventures in line with agreed criterias.
- Kuwait expects America and Gulf allies to share deployment costs.
- U.N. sees Iraqi violations to the Iraq-Kuwait demilitarised zone.
